sources.text: Product guide: EU storage region is selectable on paid plans.
Retention guide: live objects delete after configured retention (minimum 7 days); backups persist another 35 days.
Quota guide: standard plan supports 500 GB; overage requires approval.
Support note: logs process in US; EU log routing is a beta feature, with no general availability commitment.
Contract excerpt: region covers stored objects only; backups and support telemetry residency not specified.
